resources.string: Explore the simulated sky with saved zoom from 0.5× to 1×.
Weather/transparency and zoom now share consistent control positions.
0°/90° and selected-point controls adapt to portrait and landscape layouts.
New installations start with the phone-length pointing axis (0°).
Drag the screensaver Earth; after 10 idle seconds it returns smoothly to its normal rotation.
Double-tap anywhere to leave the screensaver. Updated zoom tutorial in all twenty languages.
